protocol.relevance: chunk contains >= 50% of an evidence span

abstention.signal: reranker score of the best passage

extractive.definition: sentence counts if it overlaps an evidence span by >= 50% of the shorter of the two
extractive.end_to_end_definition: answerable: passes the gate AND one of the 2 returned sentences is evidence; unanswerable: refused by the gate
